macros.name: headerfont
macros.doc: \headerfont the font used in both headers.

macros.name: leftheader
macros.doc: \leftheader[⟨pos⟩]{⟨text⟩} defines what should appear in the upper left of the first page. ⟨text⟩ may contain \\ to break lines. ⟨pos⟩ can be l, r or c and specifies the horizontal alignment (default is l).

macros.name: leftheader
macros.doc: \leftheader[⟨pos⟩]{⟨text⟩} defines what should appear in the upper left of the first page. ⟨text⟩ may contain \\ to break lines. ⟨pos⟩ can be l, r or c and specifies the horizontal alignment (default is l).

macros.name: rightheader
macros.doc: \rightheader[⟨pos⟩]{⟨text⟩} is like \leftheader, but for the upper right of the first page.

macros.name: rightheader
macros.doc: \rightheader[⟨pos⟩]{⟨text⟩} is like \leftheader, but for the upper right of the first page.

macros.name: sectionfont
macros.doc: \sectionfont the font used by \section when beginning a new topic.

macros.name: subsectionfont
macros.doc: \subsectionfont the font used by \subsection when beginning a new topic.

macros.name: titlefont
macros.doc: \titlefont the font used for the title.

macros.name: topiclabelfont
macros.doc: \topiclabelfont the font used for the items’ labels.

macros.name: topictitlefont
macros.doc: \topictitlefont the font used for the items’ titles (with option topictitle).

envs.name: topic
envs.doc: The topic environment begins an itemize-like environment where the argument of \item[] is typeset in font \topiclabelfont.
